//: Wednesday house WEB/REACT baseline (from wednesday-solutions/react-template) + the Off Grid AI-dead-code typed rules. This is the BASELINE eslint config for a Next.js / React web repo. It uses the eslintrc (legacy) format so the full Wednesday plugin set (sonarjs / security / github) and typed typescript-eslint rules compose cleanly. If your repo is eslint 9 flat-config-only, port these same extends/plugins/rules into eslint.config.js - the RULES are the contract, not the file format.

parserOptions.//project: TYPED LINTING. Point this at the repo tsconfig so @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-condition and the other type-aware rules have type info. If typed linting is slow on a big repo, keep it in CI only (see github-workflows-ci.yml) and drop `project` from the pre-push subset.

rules.//no-unnecessary-condition: THE STAR. Flags always-true / always-false conditions - the classic AI-generated dead branch (a guard that can never be false, a `?.` on a non-nullable). BASELINE-THEN-RATCHET: on a fresh repo with a backlog, set this to "warn" and ratchet to "error" once the backlog is burned down (see setup/README.md).

overrides.//: Tests may be longer and use console; relax the size/console rules there.
